# kuwai

> An Arch Linux desktop built from a Lua Hyprland 0.57 session and a Quickshell shell around a top-edge island.

## Pages
- [Home](https://kuwai.kitsunekode.in/): Overview, features, requirements, install, privacy and security, credits and licence.
- [Changelog](https://kuwai.kitsunekode.in/changelog/): Tagged release notes.
- [Brand](https://kuwai.kitsunekode.in/brand/): SVG marks, wordmarks, and core colour tokens from shell/config/Theme.qml.

## Syndication
- [RSS 2.0 Feed](https://kuwai.kitsunekode.in/feed.xml)
- [Atom 1.0 Feed](https://kuwai.kitsunekode.in/atom.xml)
- [XML Sitemap](https://kuwai.kitsunekode.in/sitemap-index.xml)

## Facts (v0.1.0)
- Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later (https://github.com/KitsuneKode/kuwai)
- Platform: Arch Linux, Hyprland 0.57+ (Lua), Quickshell (QtQuick/QML), systemd user services
- Session isolation: Installs to ~/.config/kuwai/hypr/ as its own login session without modifying ~/.config/hypr
- Themes: 13 dark theme definitions via kuwai-look; third-party wallpapers are downloaded on demand and credited in themes/*/CREDITS.txt, not shipped in the repository
- Privacy: Clipboard history and GitHub/Gmail feeds are opt-in (kuwai collect); local assistant (Ollama) is opt-in; no telemetry
